home.tagline: Find the imposter. Or be the imposter.
home.signInHint: Sign in to host your own games. Joining never needs an account.

create.title: Create a game
create.subtitle: Set it up how you like, then invite your friends.
create.modeHalfDesc: You say the words out loud. The app handles the secret words, turns, voting and scores.
create.modeFullDesc: Everyone types their words in the app and sees the list. Great for playing apart.
create.difficultyEasyDesc: The imposter gets a very similar word — easy to blend in.
create.difficultyMediumDesc: The imposter gets a same-category word — balanced.
create.difficultyHardDesc: The imposter gets an unrelated word — tough for them.
create.scoringTeamRaceDesc: The whole crew scores by how fast they catch the imposter.
create.scoringSurvivorsDesc: Only crew still in the game when the imposter is caught score.
create.scoringDetectiveDesc: Team Race, plus a bonus for voting the imposter yourself.
create.guessFinalDesc: The caught imposter may guess the word for a few points.
create.guessStealDesc: A correct guess snatches the win from the crew!
create.guessOffDesc: Caught is caught. The crew wins.

join.title: Join a game
join.subtitle: Ask the host for the game PIN.

lobby.title: Game lobby
lobby.hostNote: The host starts the game once everyone is in.

rules.title: How to play
rules.step1Body: All players secretly get the same word — except one random imposter, who gets a different word.
rules.step2Body: In turn, each player says one word connected to their word. Don't say a word from the root of the real word!
rules.step3Body: The imposter doesn't know the real word and is trying to blend in. Watch for a clue that feels off.
rules.step4Body: Everyone votes in secret, then all votes are revealed. The most-voted player is out and their role shown.
rules.step5Body: The crew wins by catching the imposter. The imposter wins by surviving. Scores add up across games.
rules.tipTitle: Golden rule: keep a straight face
rules.tipBody: Never react to what anyone says — no laughing, frowning, or "huh?". A reaction reveals whether a word fit, which hands the game to the imposter (or wrongly exposes a friend). Poker faces only!
